posts.title: Gathering A Dataset of 33 Million Unlabeled Images from Imgur
posts.description: Posted on February 21, 2024 As part of a machine learning project to build a text-to-image model , I gathered a large dataset from archives of Imgur. Well, 33 million images in around 11 terabytes sounds big to me, but there are people out there that probably ingest that much in a day. 🤷 ♂️ For my purposes, it's enough for proof of concept.
